reports.name: Example Front Company
state_basis: No company register in the countries named on its website lists this name.
Its website went online eleven days before the first report.

reports.evidence: Three candidate submissions were reviewed: the recruiter messages, the meeting invitation and the hash of the installer, compared with the cited vendor analysis.
